headline: Public hearings on self-storage at 1 Oak Hill Road, a 99-unit mixed-use complex on Main Street, and moratoriums on data centers and battery storage.
summary: Several projects go to public hearing, including a 99-unit mixed-use complex and a four-home Townsend Street development. Two proposed zoning moratoriums and a drive-through coffee shop are also on the list.
items: Approval-not-required plan at 0 Townsend St: subdivide 7.89 acres into a non-buildable Outlot A of 3.424 acres for an adjacent lot
Approval-not-required plan at 431 Westminster St: convey Parcel A (0.27 acres) to 291 Westminster Street
Special permit and site plan review at 1 Oak Hill Road, Building 5: reuse for 85,000 sf of self-storage (continued from 9-27-26)
Special permit and site plan review at 15 Central Street and nearby Main and Grove Street addresses: mixed-use complex with 99 residential units (continued from 9-27-26)
Modification of permit #2019-15 for The Healing Center at 346 River St: change operating hours to 8 a.m. to 11 p.m.
Modification of Special Permit 2025-6/SPA at 0 Townsend Street: transfer permit and split land for a four single-family home project
Modification for TMAP1, LLC at 6 Cobbler Drive: extend by one year the time to begin marijuana product manufacturing
Special permit and site plan review for Brew England, LLC at 432-504 John Fitch Highway: drive-through coffee shop
Parking plan and parking relief at 20 & 24 Granite Street for a six-unit multi-family development
Petition No. 159-26: temporary moratorium on locally regulated commercial battery energy storage systems
Petition No. 160-26: temporary moratorium on large-scale data centers
Communications: draft 2027 Planning Board meeting dates and deadlines; Moran Square project design

CITY OF FITCHBURG 
NOTICE OF PUBLIC MEETING 
 
 
*Please note: Massachusetts Open Meeting Law requires that all topics that the Chair reasonably anticipates must be listed and 
that the list of topics must be sufficiently specific to reasonably inform the public of the issues to be discussed at the meeting.  
 
 
 
APPROVAL NOT REQUIRED PLANS 
• ANR – 0 Townsend ST - The purpose of this plan is to subdivide a parcel as identified on the plan as 0 Townsend ST (Assessors 
Map 165-1-4) of 7.89 acres, into a non-buildable Outlot A (3.424 acres) to be conveyed to an adjacent lot (Assessors Map 164-1-3), 
the remaining land will be 4.468 acres. 
• ANR – 431 Westminster ST – The purpose of this plan is to permit a portion of 431 Westminster ST (Assessors Map W-2-0) 
which consists of 9 acres, labeled as Parcel A (0.27 acres), to be divided as such that said Parcel A be conveyed to 291 Westminster 
Street (Assessors Map W-10-0) which consists of 10.37 acres. 
 
MINOR SITE PLANS & MINOR MODIFICATIONS 
 
PUBLIC HEARINGS 
• Special Permit & Site Plan Review– The applicant, Bahlmann Capitol Group, proposes the reuse of a building to be outfitted for 
the use of self-storage consisting of 85,000 sf at the location of 1 Oak Hill Road – Building 5 within the Adaptive-Industrial (AI) 
Zoning District. (Continued from 9-27-26) 
• Special Permit & Site Plan Review– The applicant, Main Street Fitchburg Property Owner, LLC, is proposing the new 
construction and the reuse of an existing structure for a Mix-Use/Multi-Family complex consisting of some ground floor 
commercial and 99 residential units at the locations of 15 Central Street; 0, 721-725, 689-705, 675 Main Street; 14-18, 20-28 Grove 
Street (Assessors Map 30-78-0 & Map 42 with parcels 15-0, 16-0, 17-0, 18-0, 24-0, 25-0) within the Down-Town Business (DB) 
Zoning District. (Continued from 9-27-26) 
• Special Permit & Site Plan Approval Modification– The applicant, The Healing Center, LLC, is applying for a modification of its 
permit #2019-15 for a Non-Medical Marijuana Establishment (ME) as a Marijuana Retailer (MR), to extend the hours of operation 
from 10a.m. for an opening time of 8a.m., with the intent of operating hours to be 8a.m. to 11p.m. at the location of 346 River ST 
(Assessors Map 51-10-1) within the Commercial (C) Zoning District. 
• Special Permit & Site Plan Approval Modification– The applicant, Ed Mc Sweeny c/o Townsend Street Reality Trust, requests a 
modification of Special Permit 2025-6/SPA for a PUD of 4 single family housed on one lot. The modification request is for  a 
transfer of the  original permit and the subdivision a portion of land of the original designated parcel for the project which is 7.89 
acres into an out lot of 3.4 acres and retaining roughly 3.5 acres for the project area located at 0 Townsend Street (Assessors Map 
165-1-4) in the Residential-A (RA) Zoning District. 
FITCHBURG PLANNING BOARD 
MEETING DATE:   Tuesday, November 24, 2026 
MEETING TIME: 6:00 PM 
MEETING PLACE: Legislative Building, 700 Main St. 
NOTE: This will be a Hybrid meeting.  You may either attend the meeting in person at 700 Main St. or via the 
webinar of the meeting: For further information and to obtain the meeting link, please contact the Community 
Development Dept. at 978-829-1891 or Cfleck@fitchburgma.gov 
After registering for the Zoom meeting, you will receive a confirmation email containing information about logging in 
to join the webinar. 
To view meeting materials please visit:    https://www.fitchburgma.gov/DocumentCenter/Index/2992 
Filed in the City Clerk’s Office:
CITY OF FITCHBURG 
NOTICE OF PUBLIC MEETING 
 
 
*Please note: Massachusetts Open Meeting Law requires that all topics that the Chair reasonably anticipates must be listed and 
that the list of topics must be sufficiently specific to reasonably inform the public of the issues to be discussed at the meeting.  
 
• Special Permit & Site Plan Approval Modification – The applicant, TMAP1, LLC, was approved for the use of Marijuana 
Establishment as a Product Manufacturer on August 26, 2025 at the location of 6 Cobbler Drive (Assessors Map 114R-10-1B) 
within the Industrial (I) Zoning District. The applicant is requesting an extension of time of one (1) additional year to commence 
operations beyond the 12-month stipulation of Condition #59 of Special Permit 2025-12/SPA.  
• Special Permit & Site Plan Review– The applicant, Brew England, LLC., c/o Pedro Martinez, proposes the use of a drive-through 
coffee shop at the location of 432-504 John Fitch Highway (Assessors Map 48-1-0) within the Commercial (C) Zoning District. 
• Special Permit & Site Plan Review– The applicant, Christopher Anderson of Hannigan Engineering, proposes a parking plan with 
a request for parking relief for a Multi-Family development with 6 Units at the location of 20 & 24 Granite Street (Assessors Map 
82 Lot 130, 131) within the Residential-C (RC) Zoning District. 
Per the Zoning Act the Planning Board will consider the following petitions to amend Chapter 181 of the Fitchburg Zoning Ordinance: 
• Petition No. 159-26 — Temporary Moratorium on Locally Regulated Commercial Battery Energy Storage Systems (LRC-
BESS). The proposed amendment would establish a temporary moratorium, for up to twelve months following its effective date or 
until permanent zoning amendments are adopted, whichever occurs first. During that period, municipal applications and approvals 
would be paused for the establishment of a new LRC-BESS, expansion of an existing LRC-BESS, or conversion of a structure or 
property to an LRC-BESS use. The petition defines an LRC-BESS generally as a commercial, industrial, or utility-scale grid-
support system with an aggregate capacity of at least 250 kilowatt-hours and less than 100 megawatt-hours, and identifies exempt 
systems. 
• Petition No. 160-26 — Temporary Moratorium on Large-Scale Data Centers. The proposed amendment would establish a 
temporary moratorium for up to twelve months following its effective date or until permanent zoning amendments are adopted, 
whichever occurs first. It would pause specified City permits and approvals for construction, establishment, conversion, or 
expansion of a large-scale data center in any zoning district. The petition defines a large-scale data center as a facility primarily used 
for computer servers, data storage, or high-density computing infrastructure, including artificial intelligence, blockchain, or 
cryptocurrency operations, with a building footprint exceeding 10,000 square feet or projected electrical demand exceeding 1 
megawatt. The petition also provides for a possible extension of up to 180 days upon a Board of Health finding concerning public 
health or environmental protection. 
OTHER BUSINESS 
 
COMMUNICATIONS 
• DRAFT 2027 Planning Board Meeting Dates & Deadlines for review 
• Moran Square Project Design 
 
MINUTES
